scientific_integrity: Claims of originality exclude the general lower bound, radius-one code construction, and binary example already in Boutin–Goliber–Pelto (2014); direct full-text comparison identifies the nonbinary boundary as outside their n>=2t radius-two construction.
scientific_limitations: Only directed word length three and radius two; no claim for n=2t-1 >=5 or undirected models. Historical priority and unindexed literature remain uncertain. Finite verification is supplementary to the infinite proof.
title: Unique radius-two identifying codes at length three in directed de Bruijn graphs
